newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad R'dam to increase div pay-out ratio.
newsitem.headline: Stad R'dam to increase div pay-out ratio.

text.p: Dutch medium-sized insurer Stad Rotterdam said on Wednesday it was planning to increase its dividend pay-out ratio to 50 percent from the current ratio of just over 48 percent.
"The plan is to increase the dividend pay-out ratio to 50 percent," chairman Carlo de Swart told Reuters.
Dutch financial services group ING had a pay-out ratio of 43 percent over 1995 and Fortis Amev handles a pay-out ratio of 44 percent.
Stad Rotterdam paid a dividend of 2.10 guilders per share in 1995, with earnings per share mounting to 4.39 guilders.
The firm said last November it expected a clear increase in full-year 1996 earnings per share compared to 1995.
Fortis and ING Groep each own 20 percent of Stad Rotterdam while unlisted Achmea has five percent.
